rationale: Use +300bp level shock for V2b threshold test; +100bp comparison is one-third scale.
Linear ramp to +300bp; avoids unrealistic one-month jump but preserves rapid rate-wall stress.
Hold after ramp to allow monthly transitions, charge-off recognition, and recovery lags to emerge.
Optional linear decay after hold for extended simulations.
Reported +100/+300 q values use held-rate state, not transient month-one ramp.
Existing fixed-rate mortgage stock receives no payment shock until reset/refi/move/new origination flag is true.
Convert only shock-minus-baseline new defaults; do not convert baseline defaults or unpaid principal to demand drag.
Rationing/line cuts are separate diagnostic until a credit-supply conversion pack is supplied.
liquidity_gap_ratio = max(0, target_buffer_months - buffer_coverage_months)/target_buffer_months; multiply PD slopes by min(cap, max(floor, 1 + gamma*gap)).
